text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm back~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: How did I do? Did I run properly?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I was desperate to make sure that I 
wouldn't embarrass my Trainer, no matter 
what.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I was able to run properly... Now 
then, as a reward for letting me make my 
debut...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, there's a good girl♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Somehow... it really touches my heart. 
I'll never forget these headpats for the 
rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Let us meet again on the Classic stage... 
at the Satsuki Sho, surely."

I nod with a smile. Super Creek's eyes 
were slightly moist with tears.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right, photos! Let's take a 
picture to commemorate your debut too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, stand right there. Alri~ght, 
smile for me. I'll take the picture♪
choice_data_list:
Shouldn't Super Creek be the one getting 
her picture taken?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... that's true. That might be a 
good option too, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Shall we take a picture side by side 
then?♪

Their shy smiles were captured through the 
viewfinder. And then...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, we really need to think about what to 
do for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Our goal, the Classics. If we're to push 
forward toward that...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, how about a race like this?
What caught Super Creek's eye was—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"The Sumire Stakes. I thought it might be 
good to use it as a stepping stone to the 
Satsuki Sho, but..."

The Sumire Stakes. Normally, one would 
head for Satsuki Sho trials like the Yayoi 
Sho or the Spring Stakes.

"Is there a special reason for this? When 
I asked—"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Because~ the name is so cute, isn't it? 
'Sumire Stakes' just sounds adorable."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just the name alone makes me feel like I 
can do my best. Doesn't it give you this, 
like, warm and fuzzy feeling?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm glad~ You understand. Then it's 
settled on this one♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"If there are violets blooming in the 
racecourse plaza, let's have our lunch 
together there. Hehe♪"

Prioritizing Super Creek's mood, we 
decided her next race would be the Sumire 
Stakes.
